The graph of the function $y=f(x)$ is shown above. 
Approximate ${f}^{′}(x)$ at the point $x=3$ using a forward difference approximation with step size $h=2.$ Do not round the answer.

${f}^{′}(3)≈$
{{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the forward difference approximation

$$
{f}^{′}(x)≈\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}
$$

 
at the point $x=3.$ Applying the above formula with $x=3$ and $h=2$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(3) & ≈\frac{f(3+2)-f(3)}{2} \\  & =\frac{f(5)-f(3)}{2} \\  & =\frac{3-5}{2} \\  & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$
